query: GitHub REST API repository contents create or update file contents PUT sha
facts: Create or update file contents: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}
body params: message (required), content (required), branch, committer, author, sha
sha is required when updating an existing file (blob sha of the file being replaced); omit when creating
a stale/incorrect sha fails the request (409 Conflict or 422)
current sha comes from GET on the same contents path (response includes sha, name, path, size, _links)
response returns both a content object and a commit object
DELETE on the same path also requires sha
the contents API commits ONE FILE PER REQUEST
using the delete-file endpoint and create-or-update in parallel conflicts; must be used serially
for multi-file commits use the Git Database API (blob -> tree -> commit -> update ref)
